bylinePolicy.namedJournalist: Use the verified natural-person name only when assigned in approved article metadata.
bylinePolicy.nerminSefic: Use Nermin Sefić as author only for explicitly approved commentary, column, interview, statement or analysis authored by him.
bylinePolicy.desk: Use GNK ASG Intelligence Desk for desk-produced reports, summaries and unsigned newsroom analysis.
bylinePolicy.corporate: Use the relevant Group company as author for official notices, corporate statements, legal notices and institutional pages.
bylinePolicy.externalNews: Preserve and display the original external publisher/source; do not claim GNK authorship.
bylinePolicy.editor: Nermin Sefić is the chief and responsible editor across the Group newsroom unless a specific approved page states otherwise.
